label: z~1 at D1, ~0.03 else; D2 bump on unrewarded state switch, S2, low belief
terms: (phase == D1) * (ep_trial == 0) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state == S2) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_reward == 1) ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a1 S2 r") ;; (phase == D2) * belief_lo ;; (phase == D2) * (state == S2) ;; (phase == D2) * (state != prev_state) * (prev_reward == 0)
explanation: Raw update gate z of unit 4 is almost fully set by phase: ~0.98 at D1 (the unit copies in new candidate at fixation), ~0.03 at GO and ~0.02 at D2, rising late in the episode (timing alone gives R^2 ~1.00; the residuals are small, a few hundredths). Beyond timing, from observed quantities only: the largest effect is the episode first trial D1, where z is ~0.41 lower. At D1 z is slightly higher (+0.02) when the previous trial reached S2. At GO z is higher after a rewarded previous trial (+0.02) and especially after a rewarded rare a1->S2 trial (+0.04 more). At D2 z rises when the reached state differs from the previous trial state and the previous trial was unrewarded (a switch after a loss; occasional spikes to 0.4-0.6 late in the episode, which are under-predicted), is higher on reaching S2 (+0.017) and higher when the ideal-observer belief favours S2 (negative weight on belief_lo). 7 terms, dev R^2 beyond timing 0.574, test 0.564, above the profile all ceiling (0.53) and all-observed (0.51), so dropping model value/policy (policy decile alone 0.20) loses essentially nothing here. Future and hidden variables were not needed. Remaining misses: large late-episode D2 spikes after runs of unrewarded S1 visits.

issues: The 7 terms reproduce exactly: test R^2 beyond timing is 0.564, with the same weights. Most of it comes from one term. (phase==D1)*(ep_trial==0) alone scores 0.162 on test, a residual of -0.41 on the episode's first D1. The history, state and belief terms add the other ~0.40.

The GO reward effect is uneven. The profile residuals at GO are +0.014 after a1 S1 r but only +0.004 after a2 S2 r and -0.0006 after a2 S1 r. Unrewarded S2 trials are over-predicted: GO after a2 S2 u is off by -0.015 in misses. Adding (phase==GO)*(prev_reward==0)*(prev_state==S2) raises test R^2 from 0.564 to 0.582.

The D2 state==S2 and belief effects grow late in the episode. Adding (phase==D2)*(state==S2)*(-belief_lo)*ep_dec raises test R^2 from 0.564 to 0.586. Together with the GO term above, the 8-term set reaches 0.602 on test.

The late-episode D2 spikes (0.4-0.6, building over consecutive D2 steps, as at t84-86) are still not captured. I tried counts of consecutive unrewarded trials scaled by ep_dec or ep_trial>=80, and |belief| late in the episode. Each gained at most 0.0005, so these spikes look idiosyncratic rather than a systematic error class.

After the extra terms, systematic errors by phase x previous trial are all below 0.01 in size, and the mean error per phase is at most 0.002. The D2 (state != prev_state)*(prev_reward==0) term has a negligible weight (+0.004) and could be dropped.
The claims about the timing profile, the D1 S2 bump and the observed-only comparison (scoring above 'all' at 0.53 and above policy decile at 0.20) all check out.
